title: Government schemes for small shops and vendors
summary: A short list of schemes, with a guide for each one.

sections.heading: Schemes to know
paragraphs: This guide lists schemes that small shops and street vendors may use. Each has its own guide with the details and sources.

sections.heading: Loans
paragraphs: Mudra gives loans to small businesses. PM SVANidhi gives loans to street vendors. The details are in the boxes above.

sections.heading: Registration
paragraphs: Udyam registration can help your business be recognised as an MSME. Read our Udyam guide.

sections.heading: Check the rules
paragraphs: Each scheme has its own rules. Read them on the official site before you apply.
